faces.name: Alandra, Sky Dreamer
faces.oracleText:
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 blue Drake creature token with flying.
Whenever you draw your fifth card each turn, Alandra and Drakes you control each get +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of cards in your hand.

faces.name: Alania's Pathmaker
faces.oracleText: When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.

faces.name: Alania, Divergent Storm
faces.oracleText: Whenever you cast a spell, if it's the first instant spell, the first sorcery spell, or the first Otter spell other than Alania you've cast this turn, you may have target opponent draw a card. If you do, copy that spell. You may choose new targets for the copy.
